description: This file defines syntax highlighting rules for Dockerfile syntax for the CodeMirror editor. It sets up regex patterns for recognizing Dockerfile directives, comments, instructions with arguments, and other syntax elements, registering them under the 'dockerfile' mode.

methods.name: defineSimpleMode
methods.description: Defines a new syntax highlighting mode named 'dockerfile' with specific parsing rules.

methods.name: defineMIME
methods.description: Associates the MIME type 'text/x-dockerfile' with the 'dockerfile' syntax highlighting mode.
